scientific_integrity: Analytical global proof; verification is finite/symbolic and does not independently certify the theorem. Prior special-case complete-multipartite consensus treatments are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric nonnegative uniform-stationary chains; transitive noncomplete simple cores; one leaf per core vertex. Exact optimum for other cores, and unrestricted uniqueness, not established.
title: A sharp four-fifths fastest-mixing barrier for transitive leaf coronas
